description: This Java class configures startup validation for the Fineract application. It implements Spring's InitializingBean to perform validation checks during startup, and if validations fail, it logs an error and terminates the application.

classes.name: FineractStartupValidationConfig
classes.description: A Spring component that performs validation checks during application startup. Implements the InitializingBean interface to execute logic after properties are set, and terminates the application if validation fails.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Executed after the bean's properties have been set. Calls the terminateApplication method to perform validation-related shutdown if needed.

methods.name: terminateApplication
methods.description: Logs an error message and shuts down the Spring application context if validation fails during startup.
